name: 削除ページを編集者・場所・チーム領域で絞る検索欄
prompt:
Create one faithful Japanese search-and-filter control for Notion Trash based on the supplied references. The corrected original screenshot crop is primary for geometry and filter styling; the Japanese mock is primary for exact labels. Use a compact horizontal canvas at approximately 508×88 proportions (about 5.77:1), with no results list or extra page chrome.

Place a full-width, lightly outlined rounded search field at the top with the muted placeholder 「ごみ箱のページを検索」. Below it, place three compact dropdown filters in one row: 「最後の編集者」 with a person icon, 「場所」 with a page/document icon, and 「チーム領域」 with a teamspace/building icon. Keep the first filter in the blue highlighted pill state shown in the original; keep the other two neutral and lightly outlined as in the Japanese mock. Add a small downward chevron to each filter. Preserve the compact spacing and alignment of the source, with crisp Japanese sans-serif text, subtle borders, white background, and no broad empty bands. Do not add any page names, counts, or other text.
reviewNotes: Registered v001 with stored:true and catalogUpdated:true. The candidate preserves the Japanese search placeholder and all three filter labels/icons, but its 1981x794 (2.495:1) canvas is much taller than the corrected 508x88 source crop (5.773:1) and 416x86 mock (4.837:1), leaving broad bands; needs-correction. The source metadata crop y=408 captured Recently visited, so the reference crop was corrected to x=303,y=595,w=508,h=88 and documented. Hash matches manifest/catalog; prompt/references and HTML entry verified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
